races.title: Blackmores Build Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Olly Murphy looks to hold the aces in this novice and, seemingly the choice of Sean Bowen, TAP TAP SHAMIE earns the vote to double his tally sporting a first-time hood. His stablemate Lirion was given a considerate introduction to hurdling back in the spring and he heads up the opposition with significant improvement on the cards. Hurdling debutants Ink Black Heart and Not Without Danger can fight out minor honours. TAP TAP SHAMIE (IRE) LIRION (FR) INK BLACK HEART

races.title: Bridge Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KARAKA DE THAIX might have been off the track for a while but made such a good impression when winning in points (subsequently sold for ten times more than his 3-y-o sales price) that he gets the nod on Rules debut. Debrave Soldier can't be ignored given connections, with Titi Montmartre another to consider. KARAKA DE THAIX (FR) DEBRAVE SOLDIER (IRE) TITI MONTMARTRE (FR)

races.title: Dandara Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: BLUE IN THE WEST was right back to his best at the end of last season, and he gets the vote in a wide-open handicap. Getaway Theatre could have a big say for her in-form yard, while interesting stable-switcher Midweek Voices needs a close look. Colonial Empire is a lively each-way player. BLUE IN THE WEST (IRE) GETAWAY THEATRE (IRE) MIDWEEK VOICES (IRE)

races.title: Golwg Gwendraeth Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Anthony Honeyball has enjoyed plenty of recent success and his CORNER FORWARD is fancied to build on the promise of his handicap debut here back in the spring with this step up to 2½m sure to be in his favour. Heading up the dangers is Built By Rossies , who hasn't been seen for a while but the switch to the powerful Olly Murphy yard catches the eye making just her second handicap start. Finjimk may well emerge as best of the rest. CORNER FORWARD (IRE) BUILT BY ROSSIES (IRE) FINJIMK (IRE)

races.title: Fedwen Tentage Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Some interesting sorts coming from the pointing scene in this bumper and the Skeltons' LITTLE PATIENCE is the selection on the back of an easy win in an Irish point. Esprit Sauvage and Lancelot du Large both represent powerful yards and command plenty of respect on Rules debut. LITTLE PATIENCE (IRE) ESPRIT SAUVAGE (IRE) LANCELOT DU LARGE (FR)

races.title: RHN Travel Norton's Coin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GALWAY REEL looks set to make it 3-3 since joining the excellent Olly Murphy stable. The main danger could be Impatient , who won this corresponding race in 2023 and went close off this mark last season. GALWAY REEL (IRE) IMPATIENT (FR) SOLAR SYSTEM (FR)

races.title: 3A's Leisure Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PURE CARBON developed into a much better chaser than hurdler last season, typically travelling well when recording his third success of the campaign at Stratford in April, and he can pick up where he left off with his yard back amongst the winners. He gets the vote ahead of Rula Bula , who is better judged on the promise of her chasing debut effort. PURE CARBON RULA BULA (IRE) CENTARA (IRE)
